confirmedFindings.name: mTLS certificate urgency uses an age denominator that the server interprets as an expiry horizon
confirmedFindings.mechanism: For mqtt_mtls_cert, critical_days=14 and warn_days=60 are days-until-expiry thresholds; severityFor uses days_to_expiry, not age_days, whenever expiry is known. The controller nevertheless sorts every kind by age_days/critical_days, caps at eight, and Outlook fills age_days against critical_days. A healthy long-lived certificate can have a full bar while a newly issued imminently expiring certificate has an empty bar and low rank.
sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about two synthetic mqtt_mtls_cert rows only: A age_days=100, days_to_expiry=400, warn_days=60, critical_days=14; B age_days=0, days_to_expiry=7 with the same thresholds.
Backend severityFor returns A=ok and B=critical.
Current controller ratios are A=100/14 and B=0. Outlook clamps A to a full fill and B to zero; adding eight older positive-ratio rows can remove B from the capped urgency list.
The independent expiry watch still exposes B, but does not make the urgency metric or ranking correct.
confirmedFindings.needs: One bounded controller/outlook presentation fix must distinguish the existing certificate expiry-horizon semantics from age-threshold kinds, retaining raw API fields, signed expiry, unknowns and deterministic ordering; do not apply a backend/wire rename or invent thresholds.

confirmedFindings.name: Critical count copy incorrectly equates imminent certificate expiry with overdue rotation age
confirmedFindings.mechanism: The server can return critical for a certificate expiring in seven days with age zero. The page then says the secret is past its critical rotation threshold and labels the alert Overdue rotations; the summary repeats Past critical threshold. Its cause is a future expiry horizon, not an overdue rotation age. The optional server message is retained in the payload but not presented by this page.
sourceDerivedRepro: Use the synthetic critical certificate B from SR001.
counts.critical becomes 1, selecting the page's overdue/past-threshold alert and summary context even though last rotation is current and expiry is still seven days away.
confirmedFindings.needs: A narrow page/brief and serialized catalog followup should use accurate neutral critical-attention wording or localized cause-specific age/expiry explanations. Preserve server severity, counts and actionable attention; do not render untranslated server messages as the fix.

confirmedFindings.name: Cold paused and unsupported sources render factual empty conclusions before a successful snapshot
confirmedFindings.mechanism: The shared source model calls data undefined without error initial, including pending+paused offline. Controller isLoading instead depends on query.isLoading, which is false when an initial TanStack query is pending but not fetching. Empty arrays derived from absent data then select chart/table/outlook empty branches. The brief still loads, but expiry watch asserts that none of the tracked secrets have a hard expiry. A genuine unconfigured 503 similarly suppresses showError and selects the same expiry-empty explanation despite no successful data.
sourceDerivedRepro: Trace data=undefined, error=null, isPending=true, isLoading=false, isFetching=false, fetchStatus=paused.
deriveDataState returns status=initial and hasData=false; controller isLoading=false, showError=false and items=[].
Chart empty text, no-tracked-secrets table message and No expiring credentials/None of the tracked secrets... appear alongside the shared unavailable notice and loading brief.
confirmedFindings.needs: One source-state presentation fix should base no-data-yet on the canonical source state and reserve factual emptiness for a resolved successful items snapshot, preserving shells, paused/unsupported explanation, retained data and retry.

confirmedFindings.name: Every initial HTTP 503 is described as an unconfigured tracker
confirmedFindings.mechanism: subsystemMissing tests only ApiError.status===503. Any generic service/proxy outage 503, not only SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED, sets that flag and suppresses section QueryError. The page directs users to enable tracking in configuration even when it is already configured and merely unavailable.
sourceDerivedRepro: Trace an initial ApiError with status=503 and no SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED code.
Controller returns subsystemMissing=true and showError=false; the page and brief select Tracker not configured copy.
confirmedFindings.needs: Narrow controller classification should require supported machine-readable unsupported evidence and preserve retryable outage behavior. SR005's decoder correction is a real prerequisite for recognizing this handler's nested error code reliably.

confirmedFindings.name: Handler nested error envelope loses machine code and message through the shared request decoder
confirmedFindings.mechanism: RespondError emits {error:{code,message}}. client.parseError reads a top-level string error and top-level code, so it substitutes HTTP status text and loses the nested code. The normal JSON request falls through to resilientFetch, which also reads err.code and passes the err.error object into Error's message constructor; the nested object is coerced to [object Object]. Successful data envelope unwrapping does not fix error decoding.
sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about the handler's synthetic 500 body {error:{code:SECRET_ROTATION_FAILED,message:synthetic failure}} or configured-subsystem 503 body.
Both decoders find no top-level code; the final resilient ApiError has no machine code and its message comes from an object rather than error.message.
Canonical QueryError can still display generic status-aware recovery, but precise subsystem/error classification and technical context are lost.
confirmedFindings.needs: A separate bounded shared-client integration fix must normalize both this nested envelope and existing flat errors without changing success payloads, cancellation, retry or sudo handling. No shared-client source was changed here.

confirmedFindings.name: Six recognized credential-kind labels lack their dynamic canonical English keys
confirmedFindings.mechanism: kindLabel calls admin.secretRotation.kind.<raw> with English KIND_LABELS fallbacks. Executed canonical lookup found no entry for any of the six recognized raw kinds. This violates the fallback/catalog agreement even though fallback text prevents a blank label. It is not evidence that a cold runtime namespace or every non-English locale failed.
sourceDerivedRepro: The executed read-only canonical lookup checked 78 distinct keys and printed these six MISSING entries.
Each corresponding known kind selects a key absent from canonical English and therefore depends on the supplied English fallback.
confirmedFindings.reproductionExecuted: Canonical key lookup executed; native/non-English rendering NOTRUN.
confirmedFindings.needs: Parent-owned serialized canonical catalog integration for these exact six existing keys and existing projections; no translation campaign, new helper or catalog edit by this worker.

confirmedFindings.name: Two feature components bypass category-barrel runtime import policy
confirmedFindings.mechanism: The actual case-sensitive scan found 17 concrete runtime imports from shared layout/ui/data-display/motion/feedback modules in feature components. The concrete-internal-module exception applies to shared components, not these feature callers. Type-only MobileDataTablePresentation imports were excluded from this count.

confirmedFindings.name: Last-rotation relative caption always uses English phrases
confirmedFindings.mechanism: The detail renderer calls formatRelative without localized presentation. That helper returns literal just now, <minutes>m ago, <hours>h ago and <days>d ago, irrespective of app language or its optional locale argument in those relative branches. Both desktop and mobile quick view reuse this renderer.
sourceDerivedRepro: Select any non-English app language and reason about a last_rotated value one hour before the clock.
The source's hours<24 branch returns 1h ago, with no translation or Intl.RelativeTimeFormat lookup.
confirmedFindings.needs: A bounded detail-caption localization followup should reuse an existing localized relative-time owner if available; do not globally change dateFormat without a separate shared-owner scope.
